title: DABIN LIVE @ EDC LAS VEGAS 2026 (FULL SET)
description:
4th time at EDC and this was hands down my favorite one. Thank you EDC!!

join our discord: https://discord.gg/4u5R35CG4

Follow DABIN:
https://www.instagram.com/dabinmusic
https://www.tiktok.com/@dabinmusic
https://www.facebook.com/dabinmusic
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/7lZauDnRoAC3kmaYae2opv
Stay in Bloom fest: https://www.stayinbloomfest.com
Tour dates: https://dabinmusic.com/pages/tours

Thank you EDC and Insomniac for providing the live stream footage. 

Thank you to my media team for the additional footage: Jeffrey Zoss, Anthony Chuang, John Miyazono, Neil Chen, Brian Lee, and Tom Zhang

Thank you to my prod team for making the show look so good! 
Tour Manager & Visual Programming - Jean Phillipe Genest
Lighting/Laser Programming - Hunter Girard 
Laser Programming - Collin Theilen
Lighting/Laser Operator - Owen Howell
